name: Moshi

queries.query: Moshi Tanzania official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party results identified the Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi portal, its public GeoServer map service, the Moshi Municipal Council urban-planning page, and national survey/cadastral guidance. The official e-Ardhi WFS exposed Moshi-area parcel-like layers and bounded geometry responses.

queries.query: Moshi Tanzania ramani ya viwanja cadastral ardhi rasmi
queries.result: First-party Swahili results identified the official Ministry land-rent/e-Ardhi services, the Moshi Municipal Council urban-planning page, and Ministry cadastral-survey guidance. The public e-Ardhi WFS was then inspected for current layer, schema, CRS, and bounded parcel geometry.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Moshi Municipal Council urban-planning/land-development authority is evidenced by its official urban-planning committee page; parcel geometry itself is served by the Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi GeoServer.
registryEvidence.basis: A first-party public map service returned parcel-like Moshi-area features in bounded anonymous WFS requests. This establishes an open map/cadastre service with Moshi coverage, not ownership or title records.

requests.outcome: Official e-Ardhi landing page returned HTML and described surveying/mapping, land administration, registration, and related services. No login was attempted. The current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and exposed SERVER_URL=https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/gw, GRAPHQL_API=https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/api, and GEOSERVER_API=https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro.
Official Ministry land-rent page returned HTML. It directs some regional land services through e-Ardhi and exposes owner/title/plot search fields; those unsafe fields were not submitted or retained.
Official Moshi Municipal Council page returned HTML describing the municipal urban-planning and land-development remit. It is local administrative evidence, not itself a parcel geometry endpoint.

Current public WFS capabilities returned. Parcel-like layers included taspro:spatial_units, taspro:tp_spatial_units, taspro:survey_spatial_units, and related spatial-unit layers. WFS advertised application/json output and EPSG:4326 for the relevant layers.
Schema returned id (xsd:long), uid (xsd:string), many source attributes, and geom (gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType). Only id/uid/geom were considered safe for research.
Anonymous bounded Moshi-area request returned HTTP 200 but zero features. This exact-point/near-point miss is not treated as citywide absence.

Anonymous bounded ~10 km Moshi-area request returned 3 features (totalFeatures 1360), each with id, UUID uid, and MultiPolygon geometry. Three full geometries were retained in moshi-parcel-samples.geojson with uid as the sole canonical native identity.

Anonymous bounded ~10 km Moshi-area request returned 3 features (totalFeatures 807), each with id, UUID uid, and Polygon geometry. These were inspected but not retained to avoid mixing layer semantics in the sample.
Unauthenticated introspection attempt returned context-creation error; no credentials, tokens, or private fields were used. No GraphQL data was retained.

verifiedSample.result: Three full parcel-like multipolygons were returned from a bounded Moshi-area request. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the narrower spatial_units request returned zero.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ministry e-Ardhi public GeoServer land/spatial-unit service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A bounded ~10 km Moshi-area query returned 1360 tp_spatial_units features and three sampled full geometries; citywide completeness, update currency, and semantic equivalence to legal cadastral parcels remain unverified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent adapter qualification remains required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP latitude/longitude [-3.35251428743016, 37.3439049969071] preserved; no coordinate shift applied.
The retained sample contains only one canonical UUID identity per feature and no raw source attribute set.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
A WFS layer response and packet completion do not admit source integration or runtime use.
Zero exact-point hits and layer differences do not establish citywide absence.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
remainingUncertainty: The public e-Ardhi service clearly covers Moshi-area spatial units, but layer semantics, legal parcel status, city boundary completeness, stable identity lifecycle, and production suitability require serial review and independent adapter qualification.
